nodes.line: You didn't see me. I didn't see you. The shrimp saw us both but they're not talking.

options.label: Ask about salvage
options.response: There's a wreck off the delta with a hold full of Flock equipment. Manifest says 'agricultural.' It is not agricultural.

options.label: Mention the Form 27-B you are definitely not filling in
options.response: Forms drift in with the tide. I make sure they drift back out. Consider it filed. Or not filed. Whichever is safer.

options.label: Report in after orientation
options.response: The delta hears things. You're cleared for ladder work. The mosquitoes are also cleared. For you.

options.label: Ask about manifests
options.response: Every crate has a manifest. Every manifest has a lie in it. I collect the lies.

options.label: Move along
options.response: Tide's turning. Good time to not be here.

nodes.line: You bring it up quiet, you sell it quieter, and you never learn what it was. That's the whole job.

options.label: Agree to the terms
options.response: Then we have an understanding. The buoy's marked. The current does the rest.

options.label: Ask what the equipment does
options.response: It watches. That's all Flock equipment ever does. Now stop asking before someone writes it down.

name: Mr. Garrett Langley
role: Founder & CEO, Flock — Here to Listen

nodes.line: Hey there. Garrett. I don't do titles — I'm just a neighbor who happens to own the cameras. All of them.

options.label: Ask about Flock's mission
options.response: Simple: we make communities safer. Total visibility is total safety. A watched neighborhood is a loved neighborhood.

options.label: Raise privacy concerns
options.response: I hear that a lot, and I want you to know: I hear it. Because of the microphones. Which I value.

options.label: Ask about working for Flock
options.response: We're always hiring eyes. You look like someone with a lot of neighbors. Ever considered being compensated for that?

options.label: End the conversation
options.response: Great talk. This never happened, but it was great. I'll see you around. Technically, I already am.

nodes.line: People ask me, 'Garrett, isn't this surveillance?' And I say no. Surveillance is what governments do. We're a company. We call it stewardship.

options.label: Point out that it's a distinction without a difference
options.response: Right, but it's a profitable distinction. And profitable means sustainable. Safety shouldn't have to worry about a runway.

options.label: Nod and step back
options.response: I can tell you're a person who gets it. The cameras can too. They flagged you as 'gets it.'

nodes.line: Privacy is important. It's so important we monitor it constantly. If your privacy drops below acceptable levels, we want to be the first to know.

options.label: Ask how to opt out
options.response: Great question. The opt-out form is Form 88-C. It's not distributed, but the act of looking for it tells us you're engaged. We love engagement.

options.label: Withdraw the concern
options.response: No, no, your concern is valid and has been logged. Concerns are data. We treasure your data.

nodes.line: Here's the pitch: you watch your block, we pay you. You're not an informant — you're a Community Safety Partner. The vest is free.

options.label: Express cautious interest
options.response: Love it. Orientation's a formality. We already have your file — consider this the handshake.

options.label: Decline the vest
options.response: The offer stands. It always stands. That's not a threat, it's just good retention design.

nodes.line: The pelicans are wired. I seen one blink in morse. Nobody believes me but the shrimp know. The shrimp always know.

options.label: Ask about the pelicans
options.response: Wired. Every one. You can tell by the way they don't blink at the same time. That's the giveaway.

options.label: Ask what the shrimp know
options.response: Everything. They just lack the vocabulary. I'm working on a dictionary.

options.label: Back away from the dock
options.response: You mark my words. One day a pelican's gonna file a report on you.
